subject.title: Plugin UI: add scoped action bridge for sandboxed tabs

question: Should OpenClaw publish sessionActions and allowChatNavigation as a supported plugin SDK contract for sandboxed external Control UI tabs?
rationale: This is a new cross-plugin capability and protocol surface, so code review cannot determine the intended permanent SDK and security boundary without feature-owner direction.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow bridge contract
options.body: Approve the two descriptor capabilities after the context-window value is derived by the Gateway and the API contract receives focused compatibility documentation and proof.

options.title: Keep tabs read-only for now
options.body: Defer mutations and chat navigation until maintainers choose a broader plugin UI capability model, leaving the merged read-only gateway-tab path intact.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrow bridge contract
recommendation.body: Approve the two descriptor capabilities after the context-window value is derived by the Gateway and the API contract receives focused compatibility documentation and proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work established the gateway-authenticated sandbox-tab boundary that this proposed contract extends.
